# Generated by "Claude files/tools/build_goblin_boomworks.py" from goblin_data.py. Change the tables there and re-run.

# Country scope unless said otherwise. Their tooltips are the requirement lines of the Boomworks.

# ---- The Lab, the pool, the Tinker Bosses ----
DA_GB_lab_open = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_GB_lab_open_tt
		has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Assembly
	}
}
# The inventions book Anbennar's artifice capacity with the Artificers estate and artificery; otherwise the mod's
# Production Capacity.
DA_GB_artifice_pool = {
	has_estate = estate_artificers
	DA_SS_artificery_available = yes
}
# $cap$ free in the pool the inventions book.
DA_GB_has_room = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_GB_room_$cap$_tt
		OR = {
			AND = {
				DA_GB_artifice_pool = yes
				check_variable = { which = RemainingArtificePoints value = $cap$ }
			}
			AND = {
				NOT = { DA_GB_artifice_pool = yes }
				check_variable = { which = DA_REMAINING_Production_Points value = $cap$ }
			}
		}
	}
}
DA_GB_bosses_seated = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_GB_bosses_seated_tt
		has_estate = estate_da_tinker_bosses
	}
}
# The Tinker Bosses are angry: accidents and pressure x1.25.
DA_GB_angry = {
	has_estate = estate_da_tinker_bosses
	NOT = { estate_loyalty = { estate = estate_da_tinker_bosses loyalty = 30 } }
}
DA_GB_gnome_hired = {
	has_country_flag = DA_GB_gnome
	NOT = { had_country_flag = { flag = DA_GB_gnome days = 3650 } }
}
DA_GB_gnome_where = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_GB_gnome_where_tt
		OR = {
			any_owned_province = { has_gnomish_majority_trigger = yes }
			any_ally = { DA_RH_primary_gnomish = yes }
		}
	}
}
DA_GB_research_running = {
	has_country_flag = DA_research_in_progress
	check_variable = { which = DA_research_progress_MAX value = 0.001 }
}
# A Big Kaboom, a crater, the Lab level: the bosses see the Lab from level I.

		tooltip = DA_GB_lab_price_1_tt

	}
}

# The War Machines' vent: 25 ducats for each point of volatility.
DA_GB_machines_vent_price = {
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_mvol value = 1 } } treasury = 25 }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_mvol value = 2 } } treasury = 50 }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_mvol value = 3 } } treasury = 75 }
}

# ---- The selected slot of the board (DA_GB_sel): the generic buttons of the right panel ----
DA_GB_sel_built = {
	OR = {
		AND = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 1 } has_country_flag = DA_GB_built.stills }
		AND = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 2 } has_country_flag = DA_GB_built.pumps }
		AND = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 3 } has_country_flag = DA_GB_built.market }
		AND = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 4 } has_country_flag = DA_GB_built.conveyor }
		AND = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 5 } has_country_flag = DA_GB_built.smog }
		AND = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 6 } has_country_flag = DA_GB_built.quarries }
		AND = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 7 } has_country_flag = DA_GB_built.rumour }
		AND = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 8 } has_country_flag = DA_GB_built.telegraph }
		AND = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 9 } has_country_flag = DA_GB_built.lectures }
		AND = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 10 } has_country_flag = DA_GB_built.clock }
		AND = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 11 } has_country_flag = DA_GB_built.stealth }
		AND = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 12 } has_country_flag = DA_GB_built.organ }
		AND = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 13 } has_country_flag = DA_GB_built.walls }
		AND = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 14 } has_country_flag = DA_GB_built.mills }
		AND = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 15 } has_country_flag = DA_GB_built.borers }
		AND = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 16 } has_country_flag = DA_GB_built.pots }
		AND = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 17 } has_country_flag = DA_GB_built.wasp }
		AND = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 19 } has_country_flag = DA_GB_built.blastwalls }
		AND = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 20 } has_country_flag = DA_GB_built.sparks }
		AND = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 21 } has_country_flag = DA_GB_built.padded }
		AND = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 22 } has_country_flag = DA_GB_built.dynamo }
		AND = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 23 } has_country_flag = DA_GB_built.regulator }
		AND = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_sel value = 24 } has_country_flag = DA_GB_built.engine }
	}
}

# ---- The wonders (country scope; their province is named) ----
DA_GB_w_ours.MF = {
	owns = 4039
}
DA_GB_w_found.MF = {
	4039 = { has_province_flag = DA_Magma_forge_found }
}
DA_GB_w_rigged.MF = {
	owns = 4039
	4039 = { OR = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_1 has_province_flag = DA_GB_rigged_2 } }
}
DA_GB_w_rigging.MF = {
	has_country_flag = DA_GB_rigging.MF
}
DA_GB_can_rig1.MF = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_GB_lever_tt
		has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GB_Lever
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_GB_w_ours_tt
		owns = 4039
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_GB_w_found_tt
		4039 = { has_province_flag = DA_Magma_forge_found }
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_GB_w_tier_0_tt
		4039 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Magma_Forge tier = 0 } NOT = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Magma_Forge tier = 1 } } }
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_GB_rig_busy_tt
		NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_rig_busy }
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_GB_rig_price_tt.MF.1
		treasury = 1000
		check_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 2 }
		check_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 2 }
		check_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 2 }
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_wsel value = 2 } }
		DA_GB_can_wvent.TV = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_wsel value = 3 } }
		DA_GB_can_wvent.AC = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_wsel value = 4 } }
		DA_GB_can_wvent.DW = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_wsel value = 5 } }
		DA_GB_can_wvent.SH = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_wsel value = 6 } }
		DA_GB_can_wvent.DL = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_wsel value = 7 } }
		DA_GB_can_wvent.RW = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_wsel value = 8 } }
		DA_GB_can_wvent.EW = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_wsel value = 9 } }
		DA_GB_can_wvent.ES = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_wsel value = 10 } }
		DA_GB_can_wvent.FF = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_wsel value = 11 } }
		DA_GB_can_wvent.OT = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_wsel value = 12 } }
		DA_GB_can_wvent.BG = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_wsel value = 13 } }
		DA_GB_can_wvent.ST = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_wsel value = 14 } }
		DA_GB_can_wvent.SL = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_wsel value = 15 } }
		DA_GB_can_wvent.MV = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GB_wsel value = 16 } }
		DA_GB_can_wvent.HV = yes
	}
}

# ---- Vent All: a gauge at Hot or above ----
DA_GB_any_hot = {
	OR = {
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.stills OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.stills has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.stills } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.pumps OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.pumps has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.pumps } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.market OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.market has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.market } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.conveyor OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.conveyor has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.conveyor } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.smog OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.smog has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.smog } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.quarries OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.quarries has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.quarries } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.rumour OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.rumour has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.rumour } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.telegraph OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.telegraph has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.telegraph } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.lectures OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.lectures has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.lectures } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.clock OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.clock has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.clock } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.stealth OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.stealth has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.stealth } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.organ OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.organ has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.organ } }

		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.padded OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.padded has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.padded } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.dynamo OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.dynamo has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.dynamo } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.regulator OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.regulator has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.regulator } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_on.engine OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.engine has_country_flag = DA_GB_red.engine } }

		AND = { DA_GB_w_rigged.MF = yes OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_whot.MF has_country_flag = DA_GB_wred.MF } }
		AND = { DA_GB_w_rigged.TV = yes OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_whot.TV has_country_flag = DA_GB_wred.TV } }
		AND = { DA_GB_w_rigged.AC = yes OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_whot.AC has_country_flag = DA_GB_wred.AC } }
		AND = { DA_GB_w_rigged.DW = yes OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_whot.DW has_country_flag = DA_GB_wred.DW } }
		AND = { DA_GB_w_rigged.SH = yes OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_whot.SH has_country_flag = DA_GB_wred.SH } }

		AND = { DA_GB_w_rigged.ES = yes OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_whot.ES has_country_flag = DA_GB_wred.ES } }
		AND = { DA_GB_w_rigged.FF = yes OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_whot.FF has_country_flag = DA_GB_wred.FF } }
